# `balance_action`

Area: **billing** ([all tables](README.md))

TMF654 top-up, reservation, adjustment and transfer actions; balanceActionHistory is their projection. Money and references are immutable; only failed actions may be deleted.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | no | `gen_random_uuid()` | TMF654 action id, shared by its history entry and any reversal. |
| `kind` | `text` | no |  | topup, reservation, adjustment or transfer (the TMF654 resource). |
| `status` | `text` | no |  | TMF654 ActionStatusType: created, failed, cancelled or completed. |
| `billing_account_id` | `uuid` | no |  | Owning (sender) prepaid account. |
| `currency` | `text` | no |  | Account and bucket currency. |
| `bucket_id` | `uuid` | no |  | TMF654 bucket the action is posted on. |
| `request` | `jsonb` | no |  | Original checked request document, retained unchanged; money as exact Decimal JSON. |
| `amount` | `numeric(12,2)` | no |  | Exact amount: top-ups/transfers positive, adjustments signed nonzero, holds nonnegative. |
| `transfer_cost` | `numeric(12,2)` | yes |  | Exact tax-inclusive transfer fee; zero when absent. Transfers only. |
| `cost_owner` | `text` | yes |  | originator or receiver; who pays transfer_cost. Transfers only. |
| `receiver_bucket_id` | `uuid` | yes |  | Receiving bucket of a transfer; may be null on a refused transfer. |
| `receiver_billing_account_id` | `uuid` | yes |  | Receiving prepaid account of a transfer. |
| `receiver_currency` | `text` | yes |  | Receiving bucket currency; equals currency unless the transfer failed. |
| `reason` | `text` | yes |  | TMF654 reason as sent or edited (descriptive). |
| `description` | `text` | yes |  | TMF654 description (descriptive). |
| `failure_reason` | `text` | yes |  | Business refusal reason; set exactly when status is failed. |
| `operator` | `text` | no |  | Authenticated operator who submitted the action. |
| `requested_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  | Injected-clock receipt instant (requestedDate). |
| `confirmed_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | yes |  | Injected-clock completion or failure instant (confirmationDate). |
| `cancelled_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | yes |  | Injected-clock cancellation instant. |
| `payment_id` | `uuid` | yes |  | The done TMF676 payment a top-up records (one top-up per payment). |
| `hold_id` | `uuid` | yes |  | Funding hold of a reservation or an accepted transfer (principal plus originator fee). |
| `command_id` | `uuid` | yes |  | Owning order/renewal command of a reservation, or the transfer's worker command. |

## Constraints

| Name | Kind | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| `balance_action_amount_check` | check | `CHECK ((amount <> 'NaN'::numeric))` |
| `balance_action_check` | check | `CHECK ((confirmed_at >= requested_at))` |
| `balance_action_check1` | check | `CHECK ((cancelled_at >= requested_at))` |
| `balance_action_cost_owner_check` | check | `CHECK ((cost_owner = ANY (ARRAY['originator'::text, 'receiver'::text])))` |
| `balance_action_failure_reason_check` | check | `CHECK ((failure_reason <> ''::text))` |
| `balance_action_kind_check` | check | `CHECK ((kind = ANY (ARRAY['topup'::text, 'reservation'::text, 'adjustment'::text, 'transfer'::text])))` |
| `balance_action_kind_fields` | check | `CHECK ( CASE kind     WHEN 'topup'::text THEN ((amount > (0)::numeric) AND (status <> 'created'::text) AND ((status = 'failed'::text) = (payment_id IS NULL)) AND (num_nonnulls(transfer_cost, cost_owner, receiver_bucket_id, hold_id, command_id) = 0))     WHEN 'adjustment'::text THEN ((amount <> (0)::numeric) AND (status <> 'created'::text) AND (num_nonnulls(transfer_cost, cost_owner, receiver_bucket_id, payment_id, hold_id, command_id) = 0))     WHEN 'reservation'::text THEN ((amount >= (0)::numeric) AND ((status = 'failed'::text) OR (hold_id IS NOT NULL)) AND (num_nonnulls(transfer_cost, cost_owner, receiver_bucket_id, payment_id) = 0))     ELSE ((amount > (0)::numeric) AND (status <> 'cancelled'::text) AND (payment_id IS NULL) AND (transfer_cost IS NOT NULL) AND (cost_owner IS NOT NULL) AND ((cost_owner = 'originator'::text) OR (transfer_cost <= amount)) AND ((status = 'failed'::text) OR ((num_nonnulls(hold_id, command_id, receiver_bucket_id) = 3) AND (receiver_currency = currency) AND (receiver_bucket_id <> bucket_id)))) END)` |
| `balance_action_operator_check` | check | `CHECK ((operator <> ''::text))` |
| `balance_action_receiver` | check | `CHECK ((num_nonnulls(receiver_bucket_id, receiver_billing_account_id, receiver_currency) = ANY (ARRAY[0, 3])))` |
| `balance_action_request_check` | check | `CHECK ((jsonb_typeof(request) = 'object'::text))` |
| `balance_action_requested_at_check` | check | `CHECK (isfinite(requested_at))` |
| `balance_action_status_check` | check | `CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['created'::text, 'failed'::text, 'cancelled'::text, 'completed'::text])))` |
| `balance_action_status_times` | check | `CHECK ((((status = 'failed'::text) = (failure_reason IS NOT NULL)) AND ((status = 'cancelled'::text) = (cancelled_at IS NOT NULL)) AND ((status <> ALL (ARRAY['completed'::text, 'failed'::text])) OR (confirmed_at IS NOT NULL)) AND ((status <> 'created'::text) OR (confirmed_at IS NULL))))` |
| `balance_action_transfer_cost_check` | check | `CHECK (((transfer_cost >= (0)::numeric) AND (transfer_cost <> 'NaN'::numeric)))` |
| `balance_action_pkey` | primary key | `PRIMARY KEY (id)` |
